title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard captures a tight 1982 show highlighted by Etta James' double encore of Hard To Handle and Tell Mama, plus a memorable He's Gone drum solo.
ai_review.review: The recording boasts excellent sound quality, delivering crystal‑clear mix that lets every nuance shine. The performance is tight throughout, with the standout moments being the spacey "Feel Like A Stranger", the energetic new entries of "Touch" and "Throwing Stones", and the double encore featuring Etta James on "Hard To Handle" and "Tell Mama". A playful Billy dance behind Mickey’s drum solo adds an extra touch of fun.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive, average star rating is 4.33, and both show performance and recording quality receive strong praise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as superb and crystal‑clear with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows tightly; the first set is solid, while the second opens with new songs "Touch" and "Throwing Stones" still finding their placement. Overall the show feels well‑structured and energetic.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey delivers a notable solo during "He's Gone", with Billy adding tambourine and dancing behind him.
